questions.q: An itching, moist eczema behind the ears oozing a sticky, honey-like fluid suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Graphites: honey-like discharge, cracks in folds.

questions.q: A newborn's Apgar score is assessed at:
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Heart rate, breathing, tone, reflex, colour.

questions.q: The commonest cause of infantile diarrhoea worldwide is (GPSC Medical Officer, 2024):
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Rotavirus vaccine is in India's UIP.

questions.q: The third stage of labour extends from:
opts: onset of true labour pains to full cervical dilatation
delivery of the baby to expulsion of the placenta and membranes
full cervical dilatation to delivery of the baby
expulsion of the placenta to one hour after delivery
questions.why: The third stage is the placental stage; the hour after it is often called the fourth stage (observation).

questions.q: Koplik's spots on the buccal mucosa appear before the rash in:
The mother tincture often used in homoeopathic practice for high blood pressure is:
questions.why: Rauwolfia Q is used for hypertension; Syzygium is used for diabetes, Blatta for asthma and Berberis for renal colic.

questions.q: The infant mortality rate is the number of deaths of infants under one year per:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. A sensitive indicator of community health.

questions.q: A primigravida usually first perceives fetal movements (quickening) at about:
questions.why: Quickening is felt at about 20 weeks in a primigravida and about 2 weeks earlier in a multigravida.

questions.q: The palliative method that treats with an opposite (contraria contrariis) is called:
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Hahnemann discussed it in §§57–60; relief is followed by worsening.
